text:
Evelyn R.: heads up: found a reproducible dupes bug coming from mobile SDKs during auth key rotation + poor network. Happened in the mobile-sampleapp onboarding test.

Marco D.: can you paste repro steps and logs? curious if this is new-mobile-only or affects desktop SDKs too.

Evelyn R.: repro summary:
  1) start 10 mobile clients behind flaky LTE emulator `--loss 3% --rtt 150ms`
  2) run batch creates `mobile-load --users 10 --burst 50`
  3) trigger auth rotation at t=4s
  4) observe 429s, immediate retries from client, and duplicates (~3% requests)

Log snippet (one client):
```
WARN 2026-04-14T07:21:12Z retryer: got 429 attempt=1 backoff_ms=20 jitter_ms=0.0
INFO 2026-04-14T07:21:12Z mobile-sdk: outgoing POST /v1/session create idemp=(none)
INFO 2026-04-14T07:21:12Z retryer: retrying attempt=2 backoff_ms=20 jitter_ms=0.0
ERROR 2026-04-14T07:21:13Z backend: duplicate session created session_ab12
```

Evelyn R.: note mobile SDK intentionally kept jitter minimal to reduce perceived latency on phones. That backfired when auth rotates.

Priyanka S.: two vectors: (A) mobile should probably auto-generate Idempotency-Key for POST when app doesn't, (B) jitter for mobile should be full-jitter for backend-facing ops, even if we keep UX quick by tuning UI-level timeouts.

Marco D.: agreed. mobile SDK parity gap: desktop/node already had optional auto-idemp last quarter, mobile omitted it to avoid header overhead. But header is tiny and saves dupes. Proposal:
  - mobile SDK: auto-insert `Idempotency-Key` when missing using `rdw.mobile.<inst>-<mono>` format.
  - default retry jitter for all SDKs -> `full-jitter` (env override `REDWOOD_SDK_RETRY_JITTER=full|equal|none`).
  - mobile default min_backoff bump to 75ms for hosted envs; expose `REDWOOD_SDK_MIN_BACKOFF_MS` for tuning.

Evelyn R.: also propose `X-Redwood-Idemp-Generated: auto` header when SDK generates it so QA can trace. Mobile team: can you add `--debug-idemp` in mobile-load to print keys?

MobileBot: mobile-load v0.4.5 starting with flags: --users 10 --burst 50 --debug-idemp true.

Priyanka S.: instrumentation: emit metric `sdk.idemp.auto` and `client.duplicate_rate` per platform. Add unit test that simulates auth rotation with deterministic jitter seed (env `REDWOOD_SDK_JITTER_SEED`) so CI can catch regressions.

Marco D.: implementation notes: keep monotonic counter per process, reset on restart. For apps that care about cross-process uniqueness, allow optional `client_id` override. Add comment in mobile README about persistence tradeoffs.

Evelyn R.: for immediate mitigation, we'll flip mobile sampleapp to attach idemp header by default. Later we can flip SDK to auto-generate. QA to run matrix: mobile old/new x jitter [full,equal] x seeds [11,42].

Priyanka S.: small server-side safety net: if no Idempotency-Key present, compute request_fingerprint = sha1(payload+client_ip+user_agent) and add short dedupe TTL 6s. Not perfect but reduces dupes during auth storms. Runtime team ok?

Marco D.: runtime likes that. We'll return header `X-Redwood-Replay-Window-ms: 6000` so clients can align. Also will log `replay_hit` metric for investigation.

Evelyn R.: thanks—I'll open a PR for mobile-sampleapp change and a follow-up for the mobile SDK. I'll post QA artifacts when runs finish. :thumbsup:
